create_thread_record: create a new thread record with assistant id, user id, display name, and metadata in the in-memory store
get_thread_record: get a thread record by thread id with optional user ownership verification from the memory store
search_threads: search threads by metadata filters, status, and user id with pagination support using limit and offset
check_thread_access: check if a user has access to a specific thread and optionally require the thread to exist
update_thread_metadata: update and merge new metadata into an existing thread record with ownership verification
